name: host_output_capture
description: Verify host_run and host_run_file output is captured into variables and can be reused

test_steps.desc: Capture numeric output from a host command
Reuse the captured host command output as a variable
test_steps.host_run: test '@host_number@' = 1234 && echo 'PASS: host command output captured'

test_steps.desc: Capture numeric output from a host script
Reuse the captured host script output as a variable
test_steps.host_run: test '@host_file_value@' = 5678 && echo 'PASS: host script output captured'
